body: Ready-to-use OCR with 80+ supported languages and all popular writing scripts including Latin, Chinese, Arabic, Devanagari, Cyrillic and etc.
plain_description: The big picture: extract text from images in 80+ languages with a single line of Python — no machine learning expertise needed. Here's why it matters: automate document processing, receipt scanning, and data entry for any business workflow. The bottom line: turn any image into searchable, usable text data instantly.
technical_description: EasyOCR is a Python library for optical character recognition (OCR) supporting 80+ languages and multiple writing scripts. It uses a PyTorch-based deep learning pipeline with CRAFT for text detection and CRNN (ResNet/VGG + LSTM + CTC) for recognition. The library provides a simple Python API and command-line interface, auto-downloads pretrained models from a model hub, and runs on CPU or NVIDIA GPU via CUDA. Installation is through pip, with a Dockerfile available for containerized deployment.
title: EasyOCR
